description: Version compatibility matrix — ERPLibre platform ↔ erplibre_mobile app

matrix.notes: Initial sync support — push/pull project.task (todos), media attachments, geolocation

project_todo.description: Odoo built-in To-Do — project.task with project_id=False

base_geoengine.description: OCA geospatial fields — GeoMultiPoint for geolocation entries

erplibre_mobile_todo.description: ERPLibre companion module — adds geo_task_point (GeoMultiPoint) to project.task

erplibre_mobile_chat.description: ERPLibre companion module of the mobile chat, optional: what each level adds is in levels, what the app does without it in without

levels.1.0: erplibre_client_uuid on mail.message: a chat post sent twice is stored once
levels.1.1: erplibre_client_uuid on discuss.channel: a create called twice with one uuid by one user makes one conversation; erplibre_remove_member, administrators only
levels.1.2: erplibre_client_uuid on ir.attachment and /erplibre_mobile_chat/attachment/upload: an upload idempotent by uuid that keeps an image's original
levels.1.3: erplibre_body_fingerprint on mail.message and /erplibre_mobile_chat/message/update_content: an edit written only over the body the app read, else erplibre_conflict
levels.1.4: /erplibre_mobile_chat/message/search (member channels, by body, subject and attachment name, paged, with a count); erplibre_set_starred; uuid dedup on every mail.thread model; upload open to record threads; erplibre_chat_level, whose last Selection key is the module level (fields_get)
levels.1.5: /erplibre_mobile_chat/push/device marks the app's devices: pushes with message id and channel type, sent after commit, no endpoint logged; silent read and inbox_done pushes; quiet while a browser is online (administrator-only fields of bus.presence)
levels.1.6: erplibre_browser_mode (ring, wait, quiet) and erplibre_payload_v on mail.push.device; payload v 2 adds mentioned (@everyone included) and browser_online (polled within 65 s, active within 5 minutes); a quiet device gets no message push while a browser is active; read and inbox_done pushes stay payload v 1; the upgrade from 1.5 gives quiet to the devices marked erplibre_quiet_while_online, ring to the others

without.module: a lost post or create is found by a marker comment or a fingerprint search, uploads use Odoo's route, no member removal; closed-app notifications through ntfy work
without.1.3: the app re-reads the message before an edit and refuses it if it changed
without.1.4: search_read over the member channels, starred re-read before each toggle, a lost record reply found by its marker comment
without.1.5: no 👍 action (a 1 h mute instead), mark read by date, no read push, an Odoo warning for each push ntfy answers with 200
without.1.6: the mentions filter lets channel messages through, « wait 10 s » rings at once, « do not send » only right after the browser opens; the app sends quiet_while_online, which a 1.5 server reads

route_access./erplibre_mobile_chat/attachment/upload: HTTP POST with the CSRF token, as Odoo's own upload route; internal users only, others get NotFound; client_uuid required
route_access./erplibre_mobile_chat/message/update_con: JSON, internal users only, others get NotFound
route_access./erplibre_mobile_chat/message/search: JSON, read-only, internal users only, others get NotFound
route_access./erplibre_mobile_chat/push/device: JSON: endpoint, then browser_mode (an app 1.6: the device gets payload v 2) or quiet_while_online (the 1.5 alias, quiet or ring: payload v 1); Odoo 18 ignores an argument it does not know

erplibre_turn.description: ERPLibre module of the call infrastructure, optional: every call participant, guests included, gets TURN credentials signed by a secret shared with coturn (use-auth-secret), valid erplibre_turn.ttl_hours hours (24 by default); the app reads the ICE list Odoo hands out and needs no call of its own

without.module: Odoo hands out its own mail.ice.server rows: TODO › Deploy › Call infrastructure writes three of them (STUN, TURN over UDP and TCP) with a fixed coturn account, and TURN over TLS (turns:) is not available
